row.evidence: Tiger Data's pricing page lists SAML Single-sign-on (SSO) only under Enterprise ('Talk to us'), and its docs say Tiger Cloud offers SAML as part of its Enterprise offering; no SCIM or automated provisioning is documented.
row.notes: No SCIM by absence (rule 5): pricing page, docs sitemap (693 pages), the complete llms-full.txt docs export (no 'SCIM' match) and the Tiger Cloud REST API reference were checked. Usage-based pricing (hourly compute plus storage), so per-user fields are null; Performance compute from $30/month and Scale from $36/month as listed. SAML is Enterprise-only, set up through the CSM, IdP-initiated only. Members are invited and removed by hand in Tiger Console; the REST API has no member endpoints.

plans.name: Performance
plans.notes: Usage-based (hourly compute + storage), not per user. 30-day free trial.

plans.name: Scale
plans.notes: Can enforce MFA or SSO for project members, but SAML itself is listed only under Enterprise.

user_api.notes: The Tiger Cloud REST API reference covers projects, services, replica sets and VPCs only; it lists no member/user endpoints. Project members are managed in Tiger Console.

fallbacks.notes: Users are invited per project in Tiger Console (Enterprise/SAML users accept the invite from Console notifications); SAML setup is done with the CSM, IdP-initiated login only.
